text: PPSA CADETS PAY COURTESY CALL TO RD MASLANG AHEAD OF PPSACAT 2025 | A total of 12 cadets and three personnel from the Philippine Public Safety Academy (PPSA), headed by JSINSP DIANA C DANGANAN, paid a courtesy call to FCSUPT JUNITO F MASLANG, DSC, Regional Director of the Bureau of Fire Protection Region 11, in preparation for the upcoming Philippine Public Safety Academy Cadet Admission Test (PPSACAT) for Class 2028. The visit aimed to strengthen coordination and provide updates on the nationwide conduct of the PPSACAT 2025, which is scheduled on October 26, 2025 (Sunday). One of the designated testing centers in Mindanao is the University of Mindanao (Bolton Campus) in Davao City. For further details and updates, examinees may visit PPSA’s official website at ppsa.edu.ph or you may also follow the official PPSA Facebook page for announcements and detailed information about the upcoming exam. https://www.facebook.com/ppsa.ph PPSA CADETS PAY COURTESY CALL TO RD MASLANG AHEAD OF PPSACAT 2025 | A total of 12 cadets and three personnel from the Philippine Public Safety Academy (PPSA), headed by JSINSP DIANA C DANGANAN, paid a courtesy call to FCSUPT JUNITO F MASLANG, DSC, Regional Director of the Bureau of Fire Protection Region 11, in preparation for the upcoming Philippine Public Safety Academy Cadet Admission Test (PPSACAT) for Class 2028.
